items.title: Anthropic knowledge-work plugins
items.summary: Twenty-two plugins of role-based skills for sales, legal, finance, data and other office work, five of them from partners, each switched on by itself.
items.licenceNotes: Licences per plugin. Each plugin's own LICENSE: Apache-2.0, or MIT for the Apollo, brand-voice, Slack and Zoom partner plugins (Common Room is Apache-2.0). design, engineering, human-resources, operations and small-business have no licence file of their own and come under the repository's root LICENSE, the Apache License 2.0 text followed by four lines of notes that state no terms. Six skills also carry their own Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt. 40 skills are left out, each listed with its reason: 27 Zoom skills nested inside other Zoom skills and the 5 Zoom skills whose folders hold them (a skill folder holding another skill is refused), ui-toolkit (its name breaks the skill name rule) and 7 whose name a skill of an earlier plugin in path order already uses. Many skills name connectors nth does not provide; the text works without them.

items.title: Anthropic Claude Code plugins
items.summary: Fourteen Anthropic-written plugins with skills from the claude-plugins-official repository, among them plugin-dev, hookify, skill-creator and claude-security.
items.licenceNotes: Licences per plugin, read from the files this set downloads. Thirteen plugins carry the full Apache License 2.0 text as their own LICENSE (frontend-design's and skill-creator's skills carry an Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt too); the all-rights-reserved notice of the anthropics/claude-code repository covers that repository's copies, not these. claude-security's LICENSE, which its plugin.json names, is Anthropic's proprietary licence: install, run and modify it for internal use with Claude Code or other Anthropic products only, no redistribution; its NOTICE.md is the notice for the CWE data it carries, not a second licence. receipts and session-report are left out: their folders have no plugin.json, so no tool loads them.

items.title: Poppler
items.summary: The PDF command-line tools for turning pages into images and text.
items.licenceNotes: No Windows build from the Poppler project; this is conda-forge's build (poppler 26.09.0, build h924501e_0) as packaged by oschwartz10612/poppler-windows. Every one of the zip's 561 files equals a file of a conda-forge package whose download matches the SHA-256 anaconda.org publishes for it, or of poppler-data-0.4.12.tar.gz from poppler.freedesktop.org (ED-NEW-dl-13). Poppler is GPL-2.0-or-later as its conda-forge metadata states; COPYING is Poppler's own at the release tag, the same bytes conda-forge ships with it. The zip also carries, each under its own licence: cairo 1.18.4 (LGPL-2.1-only or MPL-1.1); lcms2 2.19.1 (MIT); libcurl 8.22.0 (curl); libfreetype6 2.14.3 (GPL-2.0-only OR FTL); libglib 2.90.0 (LGPL-2.1-or-later); libharfbuzz 14.4.0 (MIT); libiconv 1.18 (LGPL-2.1-only); libintl 0.22.5 (LGPL-2.1-or-later); libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0 (IJG AND BSD-3-Clause AND Zlib); libpng 1.6.58 (zlib-acknowledgement); libtiff 4.7.2 (HPND); libzlib 1.3.2 (Zlib); openjpeg 2.5.4 (BSD-2-Clause); ucrt 10.0.26100.0 (LicenseRef-MicrosoftWindowsSDK10); vc14_runtime 14.51.36247 (LicenseRef-MicrosoftVisualCpp2015-2022Runtime); vcomp14 14.51.36247 (LicenseRef-MicrosoftVisualCpp2015-2022Runtime); krb5 1.22.2 (MIT); libssh2 1.11.1 (BSD-3-Clause); openssl 3.6.4 (Apache-2.0); libdeflate 1.25 (MIT); libexpat 2.8.1 (MIT); expat 2.8.1 (MIT); libffi 3.7.0 (MIT); fontconfig 2.18.3 (MIT); graphite2 1.3.15 (LGPL-2.0-or-later); icu 78.3 (MIT); lerc 4.2.0 (Apache-2.0); bzip2 1.0.8 (bzip2-1.0.6); liblzma 5.8.3 (0BSD); zstd 1.5.7 (BSD-3-Clause); pcre2 10.47 (BSD-3-Clause); pixman 0.46.4 (MIT); libpsl 0.23.1 (MIT); poppler-data 0.4.12 (its COPYING, COPYING.adobe and COPYING.gpl2 in share/poppler).
